name: readme-switch-claim
title: Do the READMEs claim to list the bootstrap switches
description: The contract names all six switches the bootstrap accepts now, and the two READMEs name three of them plus an example. Whether that is a gap depends on what the READMEs claim: a sentence saying the bootstrap accepts these switches is a claim and should be complete, while a sample command is an example and should not. Measure the claim before changing anything
